sourceClaim: Keep foundational programs and choose complementary training around time, recovery and purpose. No transcript supplies an attendance-reset algorithm.
adaptation: Derive reservation credit/debt from the current period of actual core attendance. Begin at the first physical core visit; start a new period at an actual core return following a gap longer than the configured reentry interval. While the core is absent beyond that interval, use only recent selected physical opportunities. Retain existing 56-day observation for attendance/recurrence, caps, partial-work priority and all progression rules.
fixture: 18 actual engine-generated user-selected block receipts: foundation block first, then developing-only work. This reproduces changed goals/imported history, not a claim the automatic scheduler generated the old selection.
limits: This is a scheduling adaptation, not a Wildman frequency formula or a reset of earned training progression.
Continued core attendance keeps the previous balancing policy; no universal movement-maintenance frequency is established.
No load/skill advancement, source-dose change, saved program deletion, setting, storage key or user-data migration is introduced.
Synthetic and headless mobile tests do not certify physical technique or real Android acceptance.
Reservation attendance is based on the selected core block; cross-block movement-specific maintenance equivalence still requires a separate audit.
